KeyC works (says no-bench). So input is being received. Movement is the problem. The notice board at (2,7) is blocking me from leaving. 

Let me reconsider the map. The map legend: '#' blocked, '.' walkable, 'o' blocking object. My tile (2,7) shows '@'. The notice board is listed at (2,7) "blocks". So I'm standing on a blocking notice board tile — that's why I can't move (I'm embedded in it).

How did I get here? Maybe I spawned here. To escape, maybe I need to read the notice. But E says nothing there because I'm ON it, not facing it. 

Let me try: face each direction and press E — already did, nothing. Hmm.

Maybe the notice board is actually at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7) but the game considers me adjacent when facing. Let me try pressing E while facing up (toward where board might be rendered). Actually let me try all 4 with E again but check if any reads the notice.

Actually — maybe the real issue: the player Tester at (3,7) and I need to move but the game's collision is buggy. Let me try waiting — maybe time passing helps, or the player moves.
